card_lines: Before farming Onyx: Startue Exp bubble.
Griffy: golden statues only keep the highest level, so stockpile them and turn them all in on one character. Turning in every statue at once can wipe stored greenstacks.

value: Artifact - The Onyx Lantern: 3.2/4.1xHigher bonuses from Onyx or higher Statues (4 -> 7)
TRUE ZEN:1.12x higher bonuses from Zenith Statues (6 -> 250)
